title: Explicit cutoff profiles for colored top-$m$-to-random shuffles
summary: We study $p$-colored top-$m$-to-random on the wreath product $G_{n,p}=C_p\wr S_n$, with $m$ fixed. Using the Nakano-Sadahiro-Sakurai basis elements $B_m$, we obtain exact nested-set occupancy mixtures and reduce the likelihood ratio to the single statistic $L_p$. This yields exact formulas for separation and $L^\infty(U)$, and exact one-dimensional formulas for total variation, $L^q(U)$ ($1\le q<\infty$), $χ^2$, and relative entropy.
